name: Custom REST API
summary: A starter connector for your own internal API - install it, then edit the actions in the Tool Builder.

auth.setup_help: Point this at your own service. It installs one GET action you can duplicate and edit in the Tool Builder - or write a full manifest and use Add → Custom connector instead.
